failures.root_cause: sw-pipeline-test.sh E2E tests fail because the mock Claude plan/review stages don't produce plan.md/review.md artifacts (and intelligence/cleanup stages exit non-zero, with jq parse errors on non-JSON output), while the harness also reports a misleading 'All 0 tests passed' for a suite whose counters never increment.
failures.fix: Fix the mock claude binary in sw-pipeline-test.sh to emit valid output that the plan/review stages write to plan.md/review.md (and valid JSON for intelligence jq calls), and make test suites exit non-zero when the pass count is 0 or failures exist.
